definitions.short: Rephajah , the name of five Israelites
definitions.full: H7509. Rephayah רְפָיָה proper name, masculine 1. in David's family 1Chr 3:21 , Ραφαλ , A ᵐ5 L Ραφαια . 2 in Simeon , 1Chr 4:42 , Ραφαια ( ς ). 3 in Issachar , 1Chr 7:2 , Ραφαρα , A ᵐ5 L Ραφαια . 4 descendant of Saul 1Chr 9:43 , Ραφαια , ᵐ5 L Αραχα (= רָפָה 8:37 ). 5 post-exilic name Neh 3:9 , Ραφαια ( ς ). רְפָיָה proper name, masculine see below רפא . רִפְיוֺן see רפה . above,

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
Moza became the father of Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.
